items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I met him for the first time when you and I were on a record date together for the Billy Williams Quartet.

ctx.x: You remember Maxey ? He was with Cab Calloway when I joined in '36. You remember Maxey, a great drummer. I'm glad you mentioned his name. I'll tell you another guy we didn't mention yet. Of course we haven't gotten to this one fellow I'd like to say right now.

I met him for the first time when you and I were on a record date together for the Billy Williams Quartet. You and I were making a record session and this kid was in town with Earl Hines and we thought he was a pretty nice kid. You liked him and you said, "Bring him along on the date." On this particular date at the end of that take he said, "Oh yeah!" Billy Williams said, "Keep that in."

And we handed him a withholding slip so he could get paid. He came with you on the date; you was to show him what New York was about, and he wound up being what New York is really about. What was his name?
